narrative_purpose: The chapter's representative plate on the landing book-map: a human boy in the act of breathing Pandoran air unaided, his body visibly rewritten from within by a living fungal network — the single image of the oldest trick in biology run at fast-forward.
subject: A human teenager on Pandora at night seen from the chest up, in the act of lowering a breathing mask away from his face with one hand; beneath the skin of his throat, jaw, and shoulders a fine luminous cyan lattice of fungal threads glows softly, tracing the paths of his veins; from the base of his skull a slender nascent neural braid has begun to grow, wrapped in the same living light; his expression is astonishment, not fear, at drawing a breath that should have killed him.
scene: A close portrait of a human boy at the moment he breathes unmasked in alien air, the mask lowered from his face.
camera: A three-quarter close portrait from slightly below, head and shoulders filling the frame, the lowered mask just visible at the lower edge.
light: Bioluminescent key from the fungal threads glowing under his skin — cool cyan and living teal light from within; a dim indigo Pandoran night behind; a faint warm ember catchlight in his eyes as the only warm accent.
palette: Void-indigo and deep teal-indigo base, dominant Pandora cyan and living teal in the under-skin glow, scarce warm amber only in the eye catchlight, skin rendered in cool desaturated tones.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, hand-painted texture, observed-from-life confidence, luminous and atmospheric.
detail_level: Crisp and intricate on the glowing fungal lattice under the skin and the nascent braid at the nape; the background dissolving into soft night haze.
composition: The boy's face and throat fill the upper two-thirds; the lowered mask and hand at the lower edge; generous dark negative space to one side for the plate to breathe.
consistency_notes: Na'vi absent; a human subject rendered as a naturalist portrait. Cool Pandora palette with from-within bioluminescent key. The 'a body being rewritten' mood that anchors the whole chapter.
